title: Take payment when people book
blurb: Charge a deposit or full fee at booking to stop no-shows.

steps.title: Open Calendar Settings
steps.body: Click **Calendar Settings** along the top. This is where every booking calendar is built and edited.

steps.title: Connect Stripe first
steps.body: Payments need Stripe linked in **Payments** then **Integrations**. See **Connect Stripe** in the Guide.

steps.title: Open a calendar
steps.body: Click the calendar you want to charge for.

steps.title: Find the payment settings
steps.body: Open the forms and payment section of the calendar.

steps.title: Switch on payments
steps.body: Turn on accepting payments and enter the amount in NZD, e.g. $50 deposit. Save.
steps.tip: Prices here should include GST if you are GST-registered.
